title: Dack Fayden | Planeswalker
description: Learn more about Dack Fayden, the human mage Planeswalker from Magic: The Gathering.

paragraphs.text: Dack Fayden is a human mage from Drakeston, a village on the plane of Fiora. As a youth, Dack and his friend Marsh were adept mages who excelled at their abilities but lacked judgment. One night, their genius got the best of them and they picked a fight with brutes, resulting in the death of Marsh. In that moment, Dack’s spark ignited and he became a Planeswalker—and the greatest thief in the Multiverse.
